notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE (v0.99)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/10cf5d848672d2d4f8ba662a25f220082c33fb0b.png[/img]

Hey Spirits, James here, Brand Community Manager at 505 Games and working with the team at Kids with Sticks on Rogue Spirit. 

Today, we’re launching [b]v0.99[/b]. The final update before launching 1.0 next month. This update addresses several fixes and balances that the community have reported over the past few weeks. Thank you all for your help in navigating some of these. You can see all the changes below 👇

Throughout this Early Access period, you have helped us to shape the game far beyond its initial concept and we are so grateful.  

V1.0 will be a celebration of not only all the teams’ hard work but also yours too.  

We’ll be seeing you real soon. 

- 

[h3]Rogue Spirit v0.99 Patch Notes – 7th February 2023 [/h3]

- Removed the possibility of breaking other active actions with a dash action. 
- Improved dash mechanic - making it easier to dash out from difficult situations. 
- Added a ‘perfect parry’ mechanic that can block charged attacks. 
- Now if a player is attempting to block a ‘charged’ attack (and is unable to ‘perfect’ parry), the player will receive 80% of damage, but will lose some stamina, and will get kicked away. 
- Improved AI behaviour - enemies will give players more space if they are not currently attacking - this should result in less pressure during group fights. 
- Improved and rebalanced demons. 
- Fixes for AI perception and player detection. 
- Elite enemies rebalancing. 
- Boss fights rebalanced and fixes. 
- Improved freeze-frame system during player's attacks - now player should feel attacks as more powerful and less glitchy. 
- Game rebalancing. 
- Lots of bug fixes. 
- Lots of optimizations. 
- Improved Photo Mode functions. 

James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games)

notes.title: Early Access Update – v0.98 / Tokyo Game Show 2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/10cf5d848672d2d4f8ba662a25f220082c33fb0b.png[/img] 
 
 
Hey everyone, James here, Brand Community Manager at 505 Games and working with the Kids with Sticks team on Rogue Spirit!  
 
Happy Tokyo Game Show! It feels good to be back and to celebrate there again – and more importantly, we’re thrilled to announce a small update to Rogue Spirit, [b]v0.98[/b] 

Check out more info on the [b]A Journey Through Midra: Tokyo Game Show Special [/b]below 

[previewyoutube=Us7mtNdnDm4;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]Rogue Spirit - A Journey Through Midra: TGS2022 Special [/i]

- 

[h2]NEW CHARACTER: SABRE[/h2]
As part of v0.98, we’re introducing a brand-new character to the roster, Sabre.  

A strong Amazonian woman, who wields a deadly blade, Sabre is ready to slice through Famine like it was nothing! Sabre’s primary attack is a solid sharp swing of her sword, which can deal a high amount of damage with just one hit. You don’t want to get in the way of that. During her secondary attack, Sabre leaps high into the air and slams her blade down onto the ground with an all-mighty force! Be prepared, she packs a punch.  

[h2]PHOTO MODE IMPROVEMENTS  [/h2]

Virtual Photographers, we’ve heard you! 

Firstly, we want to thank everyone who’s taken the time to create some amazing shots of Rogue Spirit. When we designed our biomes, we wanted to make a world that you’ll want to capture and you’re certainly delivering.  

Photo mode is still in its infancy, and we’re taking the time to listen to your feedback and understand the tools that you want when creating your shots – let us know in the comments below!! 

However, today we’ve added a few additions to photo mode that we feel will make a big difference. We’ve added controller support to make the process of capturing your shots more familiar. We’ve also rebuilt the UI to allow for more creativity and movement within the camera, as well as adding a few more lenses. We can’t wait to see what you can create! 

[h2]ONE MORE THING [/h2]

Lastly, we‘ve got one more thing to share... we can now confirm that Rogue Spirit v1.0 is launching on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam and Epic Games on [b]March 7th, 2023!  [/b]

We can’t wait for you to get your controllers on Rogue Spirit!  

- 

[b]Rogue Spirit v0.98 Patch Notes – 15th September 2022 [/b]

- New Character: Sabre 
- Photo Mode Controller Support & Improvements 
- Bug Fixes and Optimizations 

See you in Midra, Spirits 

- James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1554970/Rogue_Spirit/

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE (v0.9)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/10cf5d848672d2d4f8ba662a25f220082c33fb0b.png[/img]

Spirits welcome to the penultimate update…

We’re nearly there. This month we’re dropping v0.9, the update before we launch v1.0 - [i]more about that soo[/i]n - and this feels like one of our biggest drops to date!

Without further a due, let’s get stuck in…

[h2]NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTERS[/h2]
Joining the fight for the Kingdom of Midra are [b]Harpooner [/b]and [b]Chief[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/66ccbd08e86dbd6a22bf5b05f467f9040b1304da.jpg[/img]

Harpooner isn’t you’re typical ranged character. Using a makeshift crossbow, he can shoot and aim his power shots with immense precision, making his primary attack superbly deadly.

His secondary attack will be familiar to fans of Slicer and Reaver - a hook shot, which when pulled off will attach to the opposing enemy and pull them closer. Perfect for those pesky ranged characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/ea4dee2756e058de83866776fa65f74d60bf2672.jpg[/img]

Chief is an experienced war chief and is exceptional at dealing - and taking - damage! For all, you hack ‘n’ slash fans, Chief should be in your arsenal! His primary attack is a heavy axe to the enemy's head, nice and simple. 

His secondary is a little different. Using both his axes as boomerangs, Chief will throw them causing them to spin and damage whoever is in his path. 

[h2]NEW BIOME: Divine Peak[/h2]
As with update 0.7, we’re introducing a brand new arena, the Divine Peak. A dangerously beautiful mountainous region that embodies what Midra once was. 

With a new area, comes a new boss the Demon King. The master of the peaks and one of our toughest bosses to date - honestly, it took me about 7 times to take him down the other day. 

[h2]NEW SKILLS AND FAMILIARS[/h2]
We’ve improved so much of the gameplay over the recent months that we wanted to add more options to fit different playstyles and as such, we’re introducing 2 new familiars[b] Vina (Electric)[/b] and [b]Canda (Laser)[/b] and a number of new skills including the[b] Frozen Orb, Electric Trap, Flamethrower[/b] and more

[h2]AND MUCH MUCH MORE[/h2]
Thanks to your feedback, we’ve added more polish and rebalancing to the enemies, changed the default camera settings and also included an ability to heal within the Spirit Bridge.

-

[b]ROGUE SPIRIT v0.9 PATCH NOTES - April 2022[/b]
New Playable Character: Harpooner
New Playable Character: Chief
New Skills: Frozen Orb, Electric Trap, Flamethrower, Frost Wall, Glue Bomb, Body Spawn
New Biome: Divine Peak
New Boss Fight: Demon King
New Familiar: Vina (Electric)
New Familiar: Canda (Laser)
Added special rooms to the Marshe biome. 
Combat polish
Game rebalancing
Changed default camera settings
Added ability to heal using the pond in Spirit Bridge

That’s all for now, Spirits. 

See you in the kingdom soon.

- James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games)

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE (v0.8)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/10cf5d848672d2d4f8ba662a25f220082c33fb0b.png[/img]

Happy February, Spirits,

It’s been a few months since our last update and we know that you’ve been excitedly waiting for what’s coming next for Rogue Spirit.

Kids with Sticks and 505 Games have been working hard behind the scenes and listening to a lot of the feedback from the Community. In this update, we’re concentrating on further improving the gameplay experience rather than prioritising new features - for the moment.

Because of this, we have decided to postpone adding any New Game Modes for the time being. This wasn’t an easy decision, but we really feel as though this is the best move for the game.

So, here’s what's new in v0.8!

[b]NEW CHARACTERS[/b]

Let us introduce you to the Marksman and Mantis, two brand new characters to join the Kingdom of Midra as part of update v0.8.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/4d6457ae3e73ca3c79f064d9237abb8ad15776f0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/9858dce53bcf7fd2081e35c925c2b356ec7fe2b0.jpg[/img]
[i]Marksman & Mantis[/i]

[b]Marksman [/b]isn’t your typical hunter. Equipped with a powerful crossbow, he can pick off his prey with strikingly impressive precision. 

His primary attack is a clear-cut combo of 2 crossbow bolts that deal a large amount of damage from a distance.

His secondary is perfect for that crowd control method that is needed in the madness - a rapid-fire attack, firing 7 arrows in a spread that can deal substantial damage against a group of enemies.

[b]Mantis[/b]’ primary attack is a deadly combination of 3 katana strikes. Slashing enemies from multiple angles.

However, her Slashing dash secondary attack is what we feel is a game-changer. She will dash between 3 points on the field cutting down her foes on the way. 

To do this, the player must set up their anchor point, once done the next placement will be a tether point where she will pass through. 

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]

As mentioned above, we want to focus on improving the gameplay loop in Rogue Spirit, and begin to finally add those important bits of lore so players can really understand the world of Rogue Spirit. 

To start, we’ve added a brand new Journal feature, which will be updated in time and yet more new comments for the Monk, which will give more details as to our story of the Kingdom and how it fell. To help with this, we’ve also created a Spirit Bridge (a hub world between levels to help you prepare for the next).

We’ve also looked at how skills have been used by players and made a bunch of improvements to allow for them to be used as they’re intended and offer a bit more flexibility.

We’ve also included loads more fun updates too!

Check out the full changelog below; 

-

v0.8 (Feb )

- New Characters, Marksman & Mantis
- An updated game loop with Spirit Bridge (hub world) between levels,
- Removed full-screen blocking player tutorials, 
- New Journal feature, which will be constantly updated,
- Added new Monk comments explaining a little bit of lore,
- New Essences,
- Polished skills usage responsiveness, 

... and see a preview of Marksman in our new Character Showcase, OUT NOW!

[previewyoutube=K8jkrAS7QIA;full][/previewyoutube]
A small, but significant one from us this time Spirits. 

Let us know your thoughts and share your favourite photo mode shots on social media with us at [url=https://twitter.com/RogueSpiritGame]@RogueSpiritGame[/url], #RogueSpirit. 

See you next time!

- James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games)

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE (v0.7)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/10cf5d848672d2d4f8ba662a25f220082c33fb0b.png[/img]

Hey Spirits,

We’re not ones for holding back on the Christmas cheer, so we thought we’d drop our next update early!!

Here’s what’s coming to Rogue Spirit in v0.7!

[i][b]New Biome - The Forest of Souls[/b][/i]
The Forest of Souls is an ancient wilderness that has been growing in Midra since before the founding of the Kindom itself. Once a holy place of worship that attracted pilgrims from all over the Kingdom, the Forest of Souls is now it’s avoided by anyone who values their life.
Defending the Forest of Souls will be Aspect of Death - the previous keeper of the Marshes, and replacing them will be…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/8a96608c6fb48309af54402e78d6d318d97dcda3.jpg[/img]
[i]Aspect of Decay[/i]


Aspect of Decay has been made to engulf the player in flames. His primary attacks include throwing his lanterns at the player, a terrifying fire tornado and a string of multiple melee attacks - some of which are unblockable.

[i][b]New Encounters & Skills[/b][/i]
We’ve added a new encounter to v0.7, built around the dashing mechanic

Players will only be able to deal damage by dashing into the enemy - no other attack will work. Each successful hit will not only deal damage but also give a “kick” effect, which causes more damage when the kicked enemy hits an object in the field. 

Sounds cool, right?

We’ve also introduced 2 new skills - [b]Fire Tornado[/b] and [b]Blink[/b].
 
Fire Tornado, creates a whirling gust of fire that slowly moves in the direction of oncoming enemies. Applying damage along the way. Perfect for mowing down the advancing Chaos.
Next, we have Blink, a very useful skill for those who are looking to be a little adventurous and play with their prey. It allows the player to be teleported behind the enemies. Very useful when combined with a well-timed parry.

[i][b]New Character - Reaver[/b][/i]
Let us introduce you to Reaver. The first thing you’ll notice is his weapon, the Kusarigama, consists of 2 parts - a sharp hook, used to slash and stab enemies, which is then linked by a chain to a weighted spike. It is known that this has been dated back to the Edo period in Japan.

His primary attack is a 3-hit combo, that uses both parts of the Kusarigama. But, when the spike is hooked onto an enemy, the combo slows down to only 2 strikes. 

Reaver’s secondary attack is to throw the weighted spike at the enemy, however unlike the Slasher, this then latches onto the opponent, and when hooked, will do damage every time the player successfully lands another hit - whether on that same enemy or another, making Reaver really good for crowd control!

Check out the full changelog below;

- 

[b]v0.7 (Dec 15th)[/b]

New Biome: Forest of Souls.
New Playable Character: Reaver.
New Boss Fight: Aspect Of Decay.
New Skill: Fire Tornado: A Tornado of Fire.
New Skill: Blink: Teleports the player behind the enemy.
New Familiar: Amara, which can revive the player, but only once!
New Challenge: Dash Kick.
Enemy types will be now selected randomly in the biomes once the player has unlocked them (unlock by possessing).
New Monk dialogue (lore and player progress)
Updated AOE damage colors: one for AI and one for player, 
Fixed graphical glitches sometimes visible on the screen when toggling ghost,
Fixed known navigation/collision issues,
Fixed known secrets that can’t be reached by player,
Fixed ghost vision walls VFX,
When changing bodies during a fight, the old character will now be visible even when left in low health,

-

That’s it for this update - and the last update of the year! 

All of us at 505 Games and Kids With Sticks want to thank you and wish you happy holidays!

See you next year, Spirits

- James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games)

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE (v0.6)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/10cf5d848672d2d4f8ba662a25f220082c33fb0b.png[/img]

Spirits, it’s time! 🙏

November’s update is here and we’re excited to finally show you what we’ve been working on.

OK, let's GO!

Firstly, let us introduce you to [b]Deadeye [/b]and [b]Slicer[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/62963161c9ea1b70af8bc731364cbc58c20f36bf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308441/e274ad9c6bd680888c1949cd302a718b47f0c777.png[/img]

Yep, these new playable characters are now available to play and we can’t wait for you to get your hands on them

[b]Deadeye [/b]is a ranged fighter that uses a powerful bow. She can be slower than other range characters - BUT her arrows are faster, more accurate and do much more damage. 

She’s perfect for picking off her foes from a distance using her primary attack - a 2-shot combo. But if the action gets too close, her secondary is a rain of arrows that can deal damage to multiple enemies in front of her. 

Next, we have [b]Slicer[/b]. She uses 2 War Fans which makes her faster and more agile than the Slasher. 

Her primary attack s a 4-hit combo. However, to help to control the Chaos you’ll need her secondary. She uses her fans as a shield, that circles around to help to protect her - but, should you dash into a group of enemies during this, then whoever gets caught up in her fans should expect a nasty cut.

As promised, we’ve also made major improvements to the combat in the game that we feel helps to make the gameplay more interesting, tactical and unpredictable - we’d love to hear your thoughts.

Want to know more about the Deadeye and Slicer, then check out Episode 2 of A Journey Through Midra NOW...

[previewyoutube=yuvSXbNgASM;full][/previewyoutube]

- 

v0.6 (Nov 24th)

Two new playable characters: Slicer and Deadeye,
Fighting: Added charged (unblockable) attacks for all melee characters.
Fighting: AI characters are using all primary attacks and combos.
Fighting: Elite attacks are UNBLOCKABLE.
Fighting: Hit reaction rules; where only stronger characters can always give hit reactions to weaker characters. If characters are the same "size" hit reaction is triggered only if another character is not currently attacking, and there is no hit reaction chaining.
Fighting: Dash can break other actions (expect hit reaction) - same as block already can do
Fighting: Stamina regenerates faster for all characters.
Fighting: Block has an increased time to parry,
Fighting: Block indicators were removed,
Fighting: Added stop frames when a player hits the enemy,
Fighting: VFX reimplementation, 

Added portals - instead of triggers - to the end level so players need to interact to move to the next level. 

Quest tracking is using save now.
Quest tracking will not be disabled after levelling the quest up.

Fixed issues with Ghost Vision not showing the valid path.
Fixed issues with save after killing the boss.
UI: added level stats during a run (can be toggled).
Moved to the new engine version 4.27.

Various bug fixes and combat balancing.

-

Phew! I told you we’ve been busy. 

We can’t wait for you to get your hands on Deadeye and Slicer, as well as experience the new combat first-hand. We’ve been having a lot of fun behind the scenes and challenging each other’s high scores and can’t wait to see if the Community can beat ours!

Also, don’t forget, you can get 40% OFF Rogue Spirit in the Steam Autumn Sale NOW: [url=http://505.games/RogueSpiritAutumnSale21]http://505.games/RogueSpiritAutumnSale21[/url]

- James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games)

notes.title: AN UPDATE FROM THE TEAM
notes.notes:
Hey Spirits,

As we near the final stages of development, the teams at Kids with Sticks and 505 Games have been giving their all into making Rogue Spirit the game that you all deserve.

We want to thank everyone that has fallen in love with the demo, played it endlessly and streamed with their communities - this is exactly the game and experience we’re aiming for and we couldn’t be happier. 

We also want to thank those that have given us feedback on making the game that they want to play - honestly, we’ve been reading it all and have been overwhelmed by your positive support.

For this reason, we have made the difficult decision to delay the Early Access launch of Rogue Spirit until Sept 1st. 

These additional few days will allow us to give the game some extra polish to ensure you have the best experience possible.

Thank you all for your understanding, patience and more importantly, your amazing support.

Keep your eyes on our channels for more info. We can’t wait to see you in the Kingdom soon. 

James (Brand Community Manager, 505 Games)
